description: Transform the clunky cursor point-placement into a pen tool: polyline click-to-place (W7a), then Bezier/Catmull-Rom curves + sensitivity toggle + ellipse/shape primitives (W7b)
wave_rationale: W7a (polyline pen) is independent of the not-yet-existing platform APIs, so it lands in the parallel green wave. W7b (curves/shapes) is sequential on green. Ultrapilot work units W7a/W7b.
notes: User 2026-07-13 chose 'build the whole pen tool' but coordinator phases it: W7a polyline lands green in the parallel wave, W7b curves/sensitivity/ellipses built sequentially. Bevy 0.18 CubicCurve family available but unused. Reuses PathTracker arc-length (linear) shared with the stamp unit.
